16 OCTOBER 2026 · IMPLEMENTATION AND EVIDENCE

More space for the photo.
Fewer competing controls.

Implemented the interface changes from the 16-finding review, preserving the shared processing engine, source ownership, project compatibility, explicit operation scope and creation-specific history.

Existing uncommitted work was retained. No commit, push, publication, signing change, new dependency or storage/module rename was performed. Human usability and physical-device verification remain open; this document does not claim Photoshop-level polish has been certified.

Finding-by-finding disposition

IDAreaImplementation / limit
01NavigationMac and iPad default to a collapsed sidebar while editing. An explicit window choice is retained; drawing drafts temporarily hide it. Large-text iPad navigation opens as a full-width sheet using the existing sidebar component.
02Document rowsPhoto tabs are smaller. History, comparison and edit actions share the photo header. The permanent photo status/Edits footer was removed, and the Mac toolbox moved to a narrow rail beside its inspector.
03Inspector densityAdjust uses the same compact controls on Mac and iPad. Reset sits beside the full slider unit instead of increasing the label row height. Watermark now has a compact content/size/opacity hierarchy and disclosures for placement/pattern and presets. Existing canvas appearance controls remain available.
04Visible historyOrdinary photo editing exposes Undo/Redo directly. Buttons use active-context history, preserving draft/photo/GIF/collage separation. New regression coverage checks draft undo, redo, Apply, photo undo, unrelated edits and batch membership.
05One toolboxMac draft tools use the same right-side toolbox as ordinary editing. iPhone Privacy and Annotate now use a fitted canvas and the same toolbox as Retouch. Apply/Cancel and changed-draft switching safeguards remain explicit.
06Phone task prioritiesAdjust, Crop and Retouch are direct phone tools. Privacy remains in Tools. Home now provides Convert and Resize without a separate Censor task; both use existing contextual workspace selection.
07Portrait propertiesAnchored tool popovers now have bounded flexible sizing rather than a fixed 320 × 440 box. Empty area options use a smaller preferred height. iPhone details use a readable sheet. Full keyboard and large-text popover interaction still need physical-device checks.
08Zoom and canvas clarityDrawing zoom is labelled “1× fit”, avoiding the misleading “100% of fit”. Ordinary editing retains a separate actual-pixel viewer. A neutral stage and output border distinguish a white Fit canvas from its surroundings. Full unification of viewport gestures and actual-pixel inspection across drawing tools is not claimed.
09Operation membershipBatch headers say operation inputs are fixed and show the separate workspace selection count. Thumbnails use an Operation input badge. Gallery View offers Show operation photos only without modifying selection or operation inputs.
10Gallery hierarchyRemoved the permanent thumbnail-size/reframing/status row. View settings and framing guidance sit in the gallery actions menu. Task scope, selection summary, search and filters remain visible where relevant.
11Export hierarchyRemoved the duplicate large Mac inspector Export button; the native toolbar remains primary. Phone collage Export moved to the native navigation bar after a screenshot caught a wrapped button. Output remains a settings tool and validated publication/sharing are unchanged.
12WatermarkEnabled watermark controls show a labelled Remove action at the top. Content, size and opacity lead; secondary settings are disclosed. Preview and handles use captured rendered output dimensions, discard superseded results, and expose source recovery on failure. Saved canvas geometry and watermark placement retain their meaning.
13GIFPhone GIFs retain the preview, transport and frame strip, with a short duration row and an Options menu for Timing/Canvas/Text. Removed the redundant GIF subheading and permanent deep timing form. Frame menus retain comfortable targets; existing frame IDs, captured settings, ordering, review and export logic remain intact.
14CollagePhone uses direct Canvas/Photo/Output property launchers, without a repeated Edit button or permanent Open Collages row. Open Collages remains in actions; Undo/Redo stay visible. Native phone Export avoids crowding the action row.
15AccessibilityLarge-text iPad uses a single-column document area with navigation available in a sheet. Tools use a readable menu instead of a giant horizontal strip. Phone header prioritises photo identity and history; additional edit commands are inside the photo-name menu. Full-resolution View becomes an accessible icon menu rather than an oversized floating label.
16Finishing detailsTool buttons use one selected treatment rather than overlapping system/custom backgrounds. Scope/override wording now uses Photo-specific edits and Uses batch settings. Percentages are concise, values align, and the Home workspace count uses singular/plural correctly.

Before and after

All app captures use synthetic local images. Before captures come from this review’s initial run, not historical marketing screenshots. Hosted native views verify presentation at a chosen viewport; they do not substitute for touch/Pencil tests. Mac test windows are borderless and omit the native title-bar toolbar.

Details checked during implementation

Live interaction checks

  • iPad: opened the synthetic photo, enabled a watermark, removed it, then used the visible header Undo to restore it. Entered Privacy, rotated the Simulator to portrait, opened Options, and inspected its anchor directly below the button. Created a synthetic privacy area through the canvas action; switching to Adjust presented Apply/Discard. Discard returned to ordinary editing.
  • iPhone: Home showed Convert and Resize, without a separate Censor task. Resize opened contextual selection, remained disabled until a photo was selected, then created a fixed one-photo batch while restoring the unrelated Workspace selection. Per-photo Refine remained a separate action.
  • These checks used isolated review roots and synthetic files. No user originals were modified, exported, uploaded or shared by the UI walkthrough.

Whitespacegit diff --check passed.

Full suite runs preceded the final small presentation refinements; later focused runs cover those changed views and state transitions. Test totals are per target, not distinct tests to add together. Screenshots were manually inspected; image-visibility assertions are not general clipping or accessibility certification.

Mac limitation: moving History capture into a separate window and moving it later in the sequence did not eliminate the exception. Isolated native GIF → collage → photo → watermark captures pass. This narrows the reproduction but does not establish whether the long sequence fails in XCTest/AppKit or exposes an application transition defect. The failing test remains enabled and is not relabelled as passing.

Remaining checks

Physical iPhone/iPad touch and Pencil use, full VoiceOver/Voice Control/keyboard task completion, software-keyboard and multitasking transitions, reduced-motion/transparency settings and first-time-user walkthroughs remain to be verified. Fit-relative drawing zoom and the separate full-resolution viewer remain distinct modes; a universal gesture/zoom system was not introduced. Mac’s long capture exception remains open. No new tools, complex timeline, layer system or panel-docking framework was added.

Implementation map

PanelComponents: navigation defaults, contextual history buttons, operation-selection explanation. WorkflowViews: compact tabs/header, direct phone Retouch and adjacent desktop tools. Inspectors: dense reusable adjustment and watermark controls. OverlayEditor: shared toolbox, fitted mobile draft canvas, anchored options and clear fit zoom. LibraryViews: lighter toolbar and operation-only presentation filter. GIFEditor/CollageEditor: focused mobile properties and export placement. Platform app shells retain native navigation and adapters. Help text was updated to match.
